commitResults.messageTitle: Make command words case-insensitive
commitResults.messageBody:
Command words reject uppercase and mixed-case input even though
several argument values already ignore case. This makes valid
commands such as ADD and Help fail unexpectedly.

Normalize command words with Locale.ROOT in parsing and error
handling so recognition and usage messages agree across locales.
Update the user guide and add regression tests for command casing,
argument preservation, and error usage.

Validation: gradlew check coverage passes with all 1,410 tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix event focus for mixed-case add commands
commitResults.messageBody:
Add-event commands accept mixed case, but the UI focus check is case-sensitive. This leaves the new event unselected for uppercase or mixed-case commands.

Match the command word without case sensitivity and cover event view switching and selection with a regression test.

commitResults.messageTitle: Accept case-insensitive parameter prefixes
commitResults.messageBody:
Parameter prefixes require exact lowercase spelling, causing uppercase
and mixed-case variants to be rejected.

Match prefixes without case sensitivity and normalize parsed prefix
keys before validation and duplicate detection. Preserve parameter
values and the spelling of unknown prefixes in error messages.

Cover command variants and validation regressions with tests, and
document the accepted prefix syntax in the User Guide.

Validation: gradlew check passes all 1,412 tests, Checkstyle, and
coverage verification.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document parameter detection rules in the DG
commitResults.messageBody:
Field validation alone does not explain which slash-containing values
command parsers accept, and the DG lacks shared terminology for these
limitations.

Define parameter-like text in the glossary and document detection rules,
examples, quoting support, and command-specific exceptions centrally.
Link attendance and filtering explanations to the shared section.

commitResults.messageTitle: Remove legacy reversed-prefix detection for events
commitResults.messageBody:
Event parsing rejects slash-leading words despite no longer supporting
reversed prefixes. Startup cleanup also removes events with these names.

Restrict the shared pattern to letters followed by a slash so event
commands and cleanup preserve slash-leading words as literal value text.
Update regression tests and the DG to describe the revised behavior.

Verify parsing, event operations, persistence, and startup cleanup with
260 passing tests. Checkstyle and the documentation build also pass.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge master into dg-param-glossary
Align DG parameter rules with the current parser
commitResults.messageBody:
The DG still describes slash-leading words as event parameters after
that detection rule has been removed.

Update the glossary, detection table, and examples to describe only
letters followed by a slash. Retain the contact-style relationship-word
exception and clarify the remaining markattendance difference.

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace interaction mode state diagram
commitResults.messageBody:
The Developer Guide describes interaction mode changes with a state
diagram. An activity diagram makes the input conditions and command
box updates explicit.

Replace the state diagram with an activity diagram and update the
Developer Guide reference and explanation.

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace leave state diagram with activity diagram
commitResults.messageBody:
The Developer Guide uses a state diagram to describe leave changes.
An activity diagram makes the date check used to display leave status
explicit.

Replace the state diagram with an activity diagram and update the
Developer Guide reference. Clarify that expired leave dates remain
saved while contacts are shown as not on leave.

commitResults.messageBody:
The Developer Guide and two sequence diagrams describe behaviour that
contradicts the implementation and User Guide.

Update startup cleanup, atomic saving, leave refresh, and use cases.
Correct manual test steps, sample tags, feedback, and attendance labels.
Clarify tag limits and session-only command history.

commitResults.messageTitle: Condense Developer Guide and improve readability
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide repeats explanations and spreads test instructions across
nested lists, making it harder to scan.

Condense prose and compare design choices and manual tests in tables.
Add an implementation index while retaining use-case list formatting,
requirements, diagrams, commands, and expected feedback.

Validate the MarkBind build, use-case flows, and diff formatting.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix documentation references and setup guidance
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide contains unused terms and diagrams, unclear filter
relationships, and launch and JDK instructions that differ from the
User Guide and build configuration.

Remove unused glossary entries and diagram sources. Link committee
handover to the glossary and explain the filter predicates and composite
relationship. Use java -jar for launch tests and JDK 25 for setup.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand DG recovery tests and define benchmark
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide lacks manual recovery scenarios and a repeatable navigation
benchmark, while two use cases include interface-specific instructions.

Add startup cleanup, concurrent-save, and unsaved-dismissal tests.
Describe attendance and restoration without UI instructions, and define
the NFR3 workload, practice trials, and timing criteria.

Validate with five targeted tests, the MarkBind build, link checks,
and diff formatting checks.

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge master into dg-consistency
commitResults.messageBody:
Integrate updated parameter parsing documentation, activity diagrams,
and tutorial layout behaviour with the condensed Developer Guide.

Preserve manual test tables, recovery scenarios, and the NFR3 benchmark
while resolving overlapping documentation edits.

commitResults.messageTitle: Fix DG navigation labels and heading anchors
commitResults.messageBody:
Repeated headings make section links ambiguous, and the guide omits
Navigation-mode Esc behaviour and uses a placeholder in an archive test.
NFR3 also contains an overly detailed benchmark procedure.

Give repeated headings distinct names, document Esc, and name Bernice Yu
in the archive feedback. Restore heading spacing and the original NFR3.

Validate the MarkBind build, unique heading IDs, local links, and diff
formatting.
